keywords: keyed nonce 并发 frame 交易
summary: 晚上 ACDE #243 上，客户端团队对 EIP-8141 frame 交易形成粗略共识，L2 的顾虑先在 breakout 中讨论，下次 ACDE 再决定是否列为头条；Glamsterdam 重定价数值敲定，升级后 200M gas limit 安全。白天 AnkushinDaniil 连发 EIP-8141 内存池 PR：不相交 keyed nonce 集合上允许同一 sender 多笔待处理交易、为规范 passkey 钱包免去模拟。Justin Drake 宣布 EF 的 L1 放弃 Poseidon，转向 SHA 或 BLAKE。

items.title: EIP-8141：在不相交的 keyed nonce 集合上允许并发待处理 frame 交易
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）提交。通用的“每个 sender 一笔待处理交易”限制源于同一 nonce 序列只能打包一笔、验证输入一变全部失效；EIP-8250 为不相交的非零 nonce key 集合去掉了第一个原因。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: allow concurrent pending frame transactions on disjoint keyed-nonce sets
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), submitted. The generic one-pending-transaction-per-sender limit exists because transactions under one nonce form a single sequence where only one can be included, and one change to the sender's validation inputs invalidates all of them; EIP-8250 removes the first cause for disjoint non-zero nonce-key sets.

items.title: EIP-8141：识别规范 passkey 钱包以免模拟接收
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）提交。现有免模拟集合只有默认代码、到期验证器和规范 paymaster，都是 `SECP256K1`；委托给 P256 签名者的 passkey 钱包即使验证只是一次 P256 检查，也要完整模拟。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: recognize a canonical passkey wallet for no-simulation admission
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), submitted. The current no-simulation set covers only default code, the expiry verifier and the canonical paymaster, all `SECP256K1`; a passkey wallet delegated to a P256 signer still goes through full simulation even though its validation is a single P256 check.

items.title: EIP-8141：枚举验证前缀的状态依赖集，无需重新模拟即可重新验证
items.note: 、禁止原子批量中的 frame 带 approval 作用域（AnkushinDaniil）提交；frame 目标为预编译时的分派（Marchhill）提交。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: enumerate the validation-prefix state dependency set for revalidation without re-simulation
items.note_en: And forbid approval scope on frames inside an atomic batch (AnkushinDaniil), submitted; dispatch a precompile targeted by a frame (Marchhill), submitted.

keywords_en: concurrent frame transactions on keyed nonces
summary_en: At ACDE #243 in the evening, client teams reached rough consensus on EIP-8141 frame transactions; L2 concerns go to a breakout first, and the next ACDE decides whether it becomes a headliner. Glamsterdam repricing numbers were finalized, making a 200M gas limit safe after the upgrade. During the day AnkushinDaniil filed a run of EIP-8141 mempool PRs: allowing several pending transactions per sender on disjoint keyed nonce sets, and skipping simulation for a canonical passkey wallet. Justin Drake announced the EF is abandoning Poseidon for L1 in favor of SHA or BLAKE.
